name: Profiles
short_desc: Your Wizard profile: share your build, look and App Store apps with friends, and try on theirs.
author: Humanity Labs
description: Your Wizard profile with its own Nostr ID. Share your build, your look and your App Store apps as Private, Friends or Everyone. Local apps never show.

form_fields.label: Who can edit this profile (your Tailscale login)
form_fields.hint: Only used to let your own Wizard screens edit the profile. It is never shown or shared; your profile ID is a Nostr ID.

form_fields.label: Your friend link (optional)
form_fields.hint: The private address friends add, e.g. https://your-box.ts.net:8842/profiles/. Your agent sets this up.
